author: SirCyaniide
body:
Jungle Warfare
Creators: SirCyanide, MapDev

Its been a long time since I've made a map, and I think you guys will like this one due to the tremendous effort my peeps and I have put into it.

I wanna thank MapDev for helping out [ALOT] in the making of this map, and for making the YML. Without him this map would look like Elysium .-. [We all know how that went]

 I also want  Polar_Express for teaching me some YML basics. 

Therefore I present to you Jungle Warfare!

Download
